blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve remarkable success, hallucinations remain a significant barrier to their reliable deployment. Recent studies primarily attribute these issues to cross-modal attention imbalances; most solutions therefore focus on reweighting visual tokens or suppressing language priors. However, such approaches often overlook the spectral characteristics of the visual information flow and frequently rely on Contrastive Decoding (CD), which doubles inference time. Instead of following conventional approaches, we identify two distinct hallucination patterns—Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation and Localized Fixation—and propose FLASH ( F requency- L ocalized A ttention SH aping), a training-free and CD-free framework. FLASH utilizes a Spectral Vortex Score to detect vision heads within multi-head attention layers and applies adaptive spectral modulation to rectify the visual information flow during decoding. Empirical results demonstrate that FLASH achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency compared to SOTA methods.
blocks.zh: 虽然大型视觉语言模型取得了显著的成功,但幻觉仍然是可靠部署的一大障碍。 最近的研究将这些问题主要归因于跨模式的注意力不平衡;因此,大多数解决办法都侧重于重新加权视觉符号或压制语言前缀。 然而,这类方法往往忽略了视觉信息流动的光谱特征,并经常依赖比对解码(CD),后者使推断时间翻了一番。 我们没有遵循常规做法,而是确定了两种不同的幻觉模式——概念-语义分离和本地化的固定——并提出了FLASH(频率-L ocalized A tention SH aping),这是一个没有培训和没有光盘的框架。 FLASH利用Spectral Vortex Score在多头注意力层内检测视觉头,并应用适应光谱调制,在解码过程中纠正视觉信息流. 经验结果显示,与SOTA方法相比,FLASH在性能和效率之间实现了优异的平衡.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) extend the functional capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling scene understanding and visual reasoning. However, hallucinations remain a formidable challenge ( Gunjal et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2024 ) , eroding user trust and compromising the reliability of generated content. These errors are especially problematic in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) and medical diagnostics ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)(Liu等人,2024a); Zhu et al., 2023 )扩展了大语言模型(LLMS)的功能能力,使场景理解和视觉推理成为可能. 然而,幻觉仍然是一个巨大的挑战(Gunjal等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2024年;Yin等人,2024年),侵蚀了用户的信任,损害了生成内容的可靠性。 这些错误在自主驾驶(Jiang等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年)和医学诊断(Yang等人,2025年;Xia等人,2024年)等安全关键应用中尤其成问题.

blocks.en: Current mitigation studies generally follow two paradigms. The first involves supervised fine-tuning or preference alignment using high-quality datasets ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Rafailov et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) . While effective, these approaches often suffer from the high costs of data curation and model retraining. Another paradigm focuses on post-hoc interventions during the decoding stage ( Zheng and Zhang, 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . These methods are increasingly favored for their flexibility.
blocks.zh: 目前的缓解研究一般遵循两种模式。 首先是利用高质量的数据集监督微调或偏好调整(Yu等人,2024年;Rafailov等人,2024年;Sun等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年a年)。 这些方法虽然有效,但往往因数据整理和模式再培训费用高昂而受到影响。 另一种范式侧重于解码阶段的后热干预(郑和章,2025年;殷等人,2025年;Q等人,2026年). 这些方法越来越具有灵活性。

blocks.en: Unfortunately, most existing training-free methods treat hallucinations merely as an imbalance between visual and textual attention—where dominant language priors override visual evidence ( Liu et al., 2024c ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, research has focused heavily on manipulating attention weights in the spatial domain, largely overlooking the intrinsic spectral characteristics of visual information. Furthermore, the prevailing reliance on Contrastive Decoding (CD) ( O’Brien and Lewis, 2023 ; Leng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) significantly increases the computational burden, hindering real-time deployment.
blocks.zh: 遗憾的是,大多数现有的无培训方法只是将幻觉视为视觉和文字注意力之间的不平衡——其中主要语言的前身凌驾于视觉证据之上(Liu等人,2024c;Kang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年)。 因此,研究主要侧重于操纵空间领域的注意力权重,在很大程度上忽略了视觉信息的内在光谱特征. 此外,目前对对照解码(CD)的依赖(O'Brien and Lewis,2023;Leng等人,2023;Wang等人,2024b)大大增加了计算负担,阻碍了实时部署。

blocks.en: These issues motivate our study to address three questions: (1) Are hallucinations merely a byproduct of simplistic attention imbalances, or do they arise from more intricate patterns? (2) Can the frequency-domain perspective serve as a potent lens for both understanding the underlying mechanisms of hallucinations and facilitating their mitigation? (3) Can we design an effective mitigation framework that bypasses the computational overhead inherent in CD?
blocks.zh: 这些问题促使我们研究三个问题: (1) 幻觉只是简单关注不平衡的副产物,还是由更为复杂的模式产生的? (2) 频域视角能否成为了解幻觉的基本机理和促进其缓解的有力透镜? (3) 我们能否设计一个绕过CD内在计算间接费用的有效缓解框架?

blocks.en: In this paper 1 1 1 Our code is available at https://github.com/a6103121/FLASH . , we demonstrate through statistical analysis that hallucinations are not merely a symptom of attention imbalance. Instead, they manifest in two distinct modes: Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation (PSD) and Localized Fixation (LF) (Fig. 1 )—each interpretable from a frequency-domain perspective. Our findings reveal that simply amplifying spatial attention often yields marginal gains, with performance remaining heavily dependent on the expensive CD (Fig. 2 ). Motivated by these insights, we shift our focus to the frequency domain and propose FLASH ( F requency- L ocalized A ttention SH aping). FLASH is a training-free framework that introduces the S pectral V ortex S core (SVS) to identify vision heads within Multi-Head Attention (MHA) layers. By applying adaptive spectral modulation to the value matrices and attention scores, FLASH rectifies distorted signals, encouraging the model to maintain granular focus on localized regions while enhancing attention to the global context. This mechanism effectively mitigates hallucinations arising from both PSD and LF. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks confirm that FLASH achieves a SOTA balance between hallucination mitigation and inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 本文中的 " 我们的代码 " 可见https://github.com/a6103121/FLASH。 我们通过统计分析表明 幻觉不仅仅是关注不平衡的症状 相反,它们表现为两种不同的模式:感知-语义分离(PSD)和局部化固定(LF)(图1)——每个模式都可以从频率-域的角度来解释. 我们的调查结果表明,仅仅扩大空间注意力往往产生微不足道的收益,其业绩仍然严重依赖昂贵的裁谈会(图2)。 基于这些洞察力,我们把注意力转移到频率域上,并提议FLASH(F renecent-L ocalized A tenty SH aping). FLASH是一个无培训框架,引入了S区V Ortex S核心(SVS),在多头关注层(MHA)内识别视觉头. FLASH通过对价值矩阵和注意力分数进行适应性光谱调值,校正扭曲的信号,鼓励该模型保持颗粒聚焦于局部区域,同时加强对全球背景的关注. 这一机制有效地缓解了私营部门司和低地层产生的幻觉。 各种基准的广泛评价证实,FLASH在减少幻觉和推断效率之间实现了SOTA平衡。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1) We demonstrate that hallucinations in LVLMs extend beyond simple attention imbalances, manifesting as two distinct patterns: PSD and LF. Furthermore, our analysis shows that although current methods aim to optimize attention distribution during the decoding phase, they heavily rely on CD, which inevitably increases inference cost.
blocks.zh: 1) 我们表明,LVLM的幻觉超越了单纯的注意力不平衡,表现为两种不同的模式:私营部门司和LF。 此外,我们的分析表明,虽然目前的方法旨在优化解码阶段的注意力分配,但它们严重依赖CD,这不可避免地增加了推论成本。

blocks.en: 2) We introduce a spectral perspective to both analyze the etiology of hallucinations and design a targeted solution. To this end, we propose FLASH. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to leverage spectral analysis as a core mechanism for analyzing and mitigating hallucinations in LVLMs.
blocks.zh: 2)我们引入了光谱视角,既分析幻觉的病理,又设计一种有针对性的解决方案. 为此,我们提议FLASH. 就我们所知,这是第一个利用光谱分析作为分析和减轻LVLM幻觉的核心机制的工作。

blocks.en: 3) We validate FLASH across diverse benchmarks, demonstrating that it surpasses or matches SOTA CD-based methods. By bypassing CD, FLASH provides a more efficient and scalable solution for mitigating hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 3) 我们通过各种基准验证FLASH,表明它超越或符合SOTA光盘方法。 通过绕过CD,FLASH为缓解幻觉提供了更有效和可扩展的解决方案.

blocks.en: A typical LVLM architecture consists of three core components: a visual encoder, a modality projection layer, and an LLM backbone ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Zheng and Zhang, 2025 ) . Both the visual encoder and the LLM are typically Transformer-based. The projection layer acts as a bridge, mapping encoded visual features into the text embedding space to ensure cross-modal alignment. These visual tokens are then concatenated with textual tokens to form a unified input sequence, from which the LLM generates responses in an autoregressive manner.

blocks.en: 3 Spectral Diagnosis of Hallucinations
blocks.zh: 3 幻觉的光谱诊断

blocks.en: 3.1 Revisiting Attention Imbalance
blocks.zh: 3.1 重新关注不平衡问题

blocks.en: Recent studies have identified a striking disparity in LVLMs: despite visual tokens numerically dominating the input, the attention weights allocated to the visual modality remain low ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024c ) . This imbalance is widely believed to induce an over-reliance on language priors, causing the model to neglect grounded visual evidence. Leading approaches, such as PAI ( Liu et al., 2024c ) , attempt to counteract this by amplifying visual attention scores to create a vision-augmented branch and subsequently employ CD to prioritize grounded logits. However, beyond the efficiency penalties arising from CD-induced inference overhead, it remains to be determined whether rescaling visual weights yields robust, independent improvements or whether its perceived efficacy is merely an artifact of the CD process.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究发现,在LVLMs中存在着明显的差异:尽管在数字上以视觉符号为主,但分配给视觉模式的注意力权重仍然很低(Kang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年c) 。 这种不平衡被广泛认为会诱发对语言前科的过度依赖,导致模型忽略了有根据的视觉证据. 诸如PAI(Liu等人,2024年c)等主要方法试图通过扩大视觉注意力分数来抵消这种情况,以创建视觉增强分支,并随后利用CD优先排序基于逻辑。 然而,除了由裁谈会引起的推论造成的效率处罚之外,还有待确定的是,扩大视觉重量是否产生有力、独立的改进,还是其预期效果仅仅是裁谈会进程的一件艺术品。

blocks.en: To respond to these questions, we evaluated discriminative performance on the POPE benchmark ( Li et al., 2023b ) under several configurations: the vanilla baseline, the vanilla PAI, PAI without CD (w/o CD), and PAI with fixed linear gains applied to visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这些问题,我们在几个配置下评价了POPE基准(Li等人,2023年b)的歧视性表现:香草基线、香草PAI、无CD(w/o CD)的PAI和可视符号的固定线性收益。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , our results reveal that linear amplification of visual attention in the spatial domain is insufficient for robust hallucination mitigation and can even be counterproductive. The observed performance gains of existing methods are primarily attributable to the CD rather than to the attention manipulation itself. Our results suggest that achieving low-cost mitigation requires shifting from coarse-grained scaling to a more in-depth analysis of information flow within the visual token, thereby bypassing the overhead of CD.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们的结果表明,空间领域的视觉注意力线性放大不足以缓解强烈的幻觉,甚至可能适得其反。 所观察到的现有方法的绩效收益主要归功于裁谈会,而不是由于注意力操纵本身。 我们的结果表明,实现低成本的缓解需要从粗糙的缩放转向对视觉标志内的信息流动进行更深入的分析,从而绕过裁谈会的间接费用。

blocks.en: 3.2 Deconstructing the Hallucination Patterns
blocks.zh: 3.2 解构迷幻图案

blocks.en: To elucidate the manifestations of hallucinations at the visual token level, we conducted diagnostic visualizations on POPE. By extracting attention weights from the 16th MHA layer and reshaping the visual tokens into 2D spatial maps ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , we performed statistical experiments comparing the attention distributions of grounded responses versus hallucination responses. The results reveal two distinct hallucination patterns in LVLMs:
blocks.zh: 为了在视觉标志层面阐明幻觉的表现形式,我们对POPE进行了诊断可视化. 通过从第16 MHA 层中提取注意力权重,并将视觉符号重塑为2D空间图(Liu等人,2025年),我们进行了统计实验,比较了被基于反应的注意力分布与幻觉反应. 这些结果揭示了LVLM的两种不同的幻觉模式:

blocks.en: (1) Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation (PSD). This pattern signifies a rupture between spatial localization and semantic interpretation. The model successfully ”anchors” its attention to the correct visual region but fails to execute fine-grained semantic parsing. As shown in Fig. 1 a, when queried about the ”bench” and the ”chair,” the model’s attention consistently converges on the exact same spatial coordinates (the ground-truth location of the bench). This suggests that although the model possesses the perceptual capacity to localize regions based on textual prompts, it lacks the discriminative resolution to distinguish fine-grained features (e.g., the elongated form of a bench), resulting in a semantic best guess rather than grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh: (1)观念-语义分离(PSD). 这种模式意味着空间定位和语义解释之间的破裂。 该模型成功地“锁定者”关注正确的视觉区域,但未能执行精细的语义解析。 如图1a所示,当问及“座椅”和“座椅”时,模型的注意力始终集中在完全相同的空间坐标上(座椅的地面-真实位置)。 这表明,虽然该模型具有以文字提示为基础的区域本地化的感知能力,但它缺乏区分精细特征(例如长长的长凳形式)的歧视性分辨率,导致语义上的最佳猜测而不是有根据的推理.

blocks.en: (2) Localized Fixation (LF). This pattern manifests as a pathological capture of attention by irrelevant visual locations. As shown in Fig. 1 b, the model frequently becomes trapped within contiguous regions that offer marginal semantic utility for the current token generation. Although similar to the ”attention sink” ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2025 ) , LF is distinguished by its intense spatial contiguousness—attention is concentrated in dense, localized patches rather than distributed across sparse outliers. This indicates that the model is not merely ignoring visual tokens but is actively distracted by localized noise, which obscures its contextual observational perspective and induces a drift toward hallucinated responses.
blocks.zh: (2)本地化修复(LF). 这种模式表现为不相关的视觉地点对注意力的病理捕捉. 如图1b所示,该模型经常被困在为当前代号提供边际语义功能的毗连区域。 虽然与“注意沉积”相似(Xiao等人,2024年;Kang等人,2025年),但LF因其密集的空间毗连性而有所区别——注意集中在密集的局部斑点上,而不是分布在稀疏的外围地区。 这表明该模型不仅忽略了视觉标志,而且被局部噪声积极分心,这些噪声模糊了其背景观测视角,并诱发向幻觉反应的漂移.

blocks.en: Consequently, an indiscriminate ”one-size-fits-all” enhancement of visual tokens is inadequate for addressing the diverse modes of hallucinations. It is necessary to establish a unified framework to tackle different hallucination patterns.
blocks.zh: 因此,不分青红皂白地“一刀切”地增强视觉标志不足以解决各种幻觉模式。 必须建立一个统一的框架来处理不同的幻觉模式。

blocks.en: 3.3 Spectral Analysis of Information Flow within MHA
blocks.zh: 3.3 对卫生部内部信息流动的光谱分析

blocks.en: Spectral components serve distinct roles. To quantify the impact of spectral composition on model performance, we performed spectral perturbation analysis by modulating the cutoff frequency of a low-pass filter applied to the hidden states. As shown in Fig. 3 a, the model exhibits nonlinear sensitivity to filter cutoff: performance remains stable when high-frequency components remain below 0.4, begin to decline at 0.5, and collapse by 0.8. This suggests that low-frequency components underpin the model’s baseline reliability, whereas high-frequency components govern its performance bottlenecks.

As shown in Fig. 3 b, a gap persists between the raw visual features and their aggregated representations across all layers. blocks.en: To mitigate the diverse patterns of object hallucinations, we introduce Dual-stream Spectrum Modulation (DSM), a strategy designed to adaptively modulate the information flow of visual tokens in the decoder. Diverging from spatial-domain reweighting ( Liu et al., 2024c ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , DSM performs adaptive redistribution of spectral energy within both the attention scores and value matrices. By operating in the spectral domain, DSM circumvents the heavy computational overhead of CD and mitigates noise-induced interference common in spatial manipulations. Furthermore, this approach enhances the interpretability of the model’s internal representations.

In contrast, our proposed modulation—leveraging the synergy between Eq. 13 and Eq. 15 —acts as a spectral energy reallocation mechanism. According to Parseval’s Theorem 2 2 2 Parseval’s Theorem: The total energy of a signal in the time domain equals that in the frequency domain. , enforcing a constant F-norm constraint ensures that amplification of high-frequency components inherently squeezes redundant energy from low-frequency bands and reallocates it to suppressed fine-grained details. This intrinsic zero-sum energy dynamic enables the model to refocus on fine-grained semantic features without shifting global feature magnitudes or compromising pre-trained multimodal alignment. Please refer to Appendix A.3 for theoretical details. Consequently, this modulation provides a robust, plug-and-play solution for mitigating PSD while preserving numerical stability in the representation space.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Data-Driven Instruction Tuning methods focus on improving data quality and using specialized instruction tuning to better anchor models in visual evidence. Early research suggested that hallucinations often stem from a mismatch between visual features and the model’s language priors. LLaVA-1.5 ( Liu et al., 2024a ) demonstrated that high-quality data coupled with a simplified linear projector is more effective than dataset size in mitigating hallucinations. ShareGPT4V ( Chen et al., 2023b ) extended this by using detailed image descriptions generated by proprietary models to sharpen the model’s perception of fine-grained attributes. To address ”over-generalization,” RLHF-V ( Yu et al., 2024 ) introduced segment-level corrective feedback via reinforcement learning, whereas Silkie ( Li et al., 2023a ) and LLaVA-RLHF ( Sun et al., 2023 ) adopted Direct Preference Optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2024 ) to encourage factual consistency. More recently, Bunny ( He et al., 2024 ) and LLaVA-NeXT ( Li et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) identified low spatial resolution as a key driver of errors in small-object recognition, leading them to advocate for higher-resolution visual inputs. Although these methods yield significant improvements, they remain constrained by the high cost of data collection, complex training pipelines, and heavy computational requirements.
blocks.zh: 数据驱动指令 训导方法注重于提高数据质量,并使用专门的指令调制,以更好地锁定视觉证据中的模型. 早期的研究表明,幻觉往往源于视觉特征与模型语言前科的不匹配. LLaVA-1.5(Liu等人,2024年a)证明,高质量的数据加上简化的线性投影仪比数据集大小更能缓解幻觉. ShareGPT4V(Chen et al., 2023b)通过使用专有模型生成的详细图像描述来强化模型对细纹属性的感知,扩展了这一点. 为了解决“过度普遍化”问题,RLHF-V(Yu等人,2024年)通过强化学习引入了分层矫正反馈,而Silki(Li等人,2023年a)和LLaVA-RLHF(Sun等人,2023年)通过了直接优化(Rafailov等人,2024年)以鼓励事实一致性。 最近,Bunny(He等人,2024年)和LLaVA-NEXT(Li等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年b)将低空间分辨率确定为小对象识别错误的关键驱动力,导致他们倡导高分辨率的视觉输入. 虽然这些方法有重大改进,但由于数据收集费用高昂、培训管道复杂和计算要求繁重,它们仍然受到限制。

blocks.en: Training-Free Decoding Intervention. Prior research ( Liu et al., 2024c ; Leng et al., 2023 ) indicates that hallucinations in LVLMs during autoregressive generation primarily stem from an over-reliance on linguistic priors, which hinders the model’s ability to ground its outputs in actual visual evidence. To bypass the costs of retraining, the research community has increasingly turned to plug-and-play interventions applied during the decoding phase. Early schemes focused on analyzing spatial attention distributions; for instance, OPERA ( Huang et al., 2024 ) identified the over-trust pitfall where models fixate on specific tokens. Building on CD, VCD ( Leng et al., 2023 ) introduced Gaussian noise to construct contrastive samples that counteract linguistic bias. This paradigm has inspired numerous variants: PAI ( Liu et al., 2024c ) amplifies visual grounding by modulating attention scores; DoLA ( Chuang et al., 2024 ) and ICD ( Wang et al., 2024b ) mitigate signal submergence through layer-wise contrast or instruction-based bias calibration. Similarly, M3ID ( Favero et al., 2024 ) , IBD ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , and Octopus ( Suo et al., 2025 ) have refined the CD framework through multi-layer feature contrast and strategic integration.
blocks.zh: 培训-免费解码干预。 先前的研究(Liu等人,2024c;Leng等人,2023年)表明,自旋生成过程中LVLM的幻觉主要源于对语言学前科的过度依赖,这阻碍了模型在实际视觉证据中定位其输出的能力. 为了避免再培训的费用,研究界越来越多地转向在解码阶段采用的插播和游戏干预。 早期计划的重点是分析空间注意力分布;例如,OPERA(Huang等人,2024年)确定了模型固定在具体标志上的过度信任陷阱。 在CD的基础上,VCD(Leng等人,2023年)引入了高斯噪声来构建对抗语言偏见的对比性样本. 这个范式激发了许多变体:PAI(Liu等人,2024c)通过调制注意力分数来放大视觉地面;DoLA(Chuang等人,2024b)和ICD(Wang等人,2024b)通过分层对比或基于指令的偏差校准来缓解信号下沉. 同样,M3ID(Favero等人,2024年),IBD(Zhu等人,2024年),Octopus(Suo等人,2025年)通过多层次特征对比和战略整合,完善了CD框架.

blocks.en: Despite performing well, CD-based methods are inherently limited by a doubling of inference latency. Furthermore, the introduction of contrastive noise can occasionally compromise generative quality ( Huo et al., 2025 ) . Recent efficient alternatives like VAF ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , ADAPTVIS ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and VAR ( Kang et al., 2025 ) have begun exploring internal mechanisms—such as energy distribution or logit calibration—to bypass the dual-stream architecture. In this paper, we depart from conventional spatial-domain manipulations by pioneering a spectral analysis of hallucination dynamics.
blocks.zh: 尽管成绩良好,但基于CD的方法由于推论的延迟性翻了一番而受到固有的限制。 此外,引入对比性噪音有时会损害基因质量(Huo等人,2025年)。 诸如VAF(Yin等人,2025年),ADAPTVIS(Chen等人,2025年)和VAR(Kang等人,2025年)等近期高效替代品已开始探索绕过双流结构的内部机制——如能源分配或登录校准。 在本文中,我们对幻觉动力学进行了光谱分析,从而背离了传统的空间领域操纵.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion & Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 结论和讨论

blocks.en: In this paper, we demonstrate that the effectiveness of recent post-hoc hallucination mitigation methods heavily relies on CD strategies, which incur a substantial computational penalty. By analyzing the spatial attention representations of visual tokens and their spectral features, we refine the types of hallucinations into PSD and LF. To address these, we introduce FLASH, which is a training-free framework that mitigates hallucinations from a spectral perspective. FLASH incorporates two core components: vision head selection and dual-stream adaptive spectral modulation. Experimental results confirm that FLASH outperforms SOTA methods in balancing performance and efficiency, successfully bypassing the standard CD paradigm through targeted processing of distinct hallucinatory patterns.
blocks.zh: 在这份文件中,我们表明,最近减少危险后幻觉方法的有效性很大程度上依赖于裁谈会的战略,这种战略将受到重大的计算惩罚。 通过分析视觉符号的空间注意度表现及其光谱特征,我们把幻觉的种类改进为私营部门司和低频。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了FLASH,这是一个从光谱角度减轻幻觉的无培训框架. FLASH包含了两个核心部分:视觉头选择和双流适应光谱调制. 实验结果证实FLASH在平衡性能和效率方面超越了SOTA方法,通过有针对性地处理明显的幻觉模式,成功绕过标准的CD范式.

blocks.en: Despite its efficacy, FLASH entails certain technical limitations. First, although it circumvents the CD paradigm and significantly reduces computational complexity, FLASH still relies on multiple spectral transformations and filtering operations. Second, future research may enable targeted modulation of hallucinations by identifying their underlying patterns—thereby further minimizing inference latency. Third, FLASH simultaneously applies value modulation and attention modulation; decoupling or selectively applying these modulations could yield more targeted mitigation strategies while accelerating overall processing. Finally, due to FLASH’s analytical design principles, it remains unclear whether it is applicable to Q-Former-based models. We will prioritize these directions in our future work.

blocks.zh: POPE(Li等人,2023年b): 基于投票的物体检测评价(POPE)旨在评价LVLMs中的幻觉. 它包括三个数据集:MSCO(Lin等人,2015年),A-OKVQA(Schwenk等人,2022年),以及GQA(Hudson and Manning,2019年). 在VQA任务的基础上,POPE将每个数据集分为三块——随机,大众,和逆差——共计27,000个查询. 每个分解的500个图像样本,每个图像使用模板有六个问题:......” 图像中是否有 {对象} ? ” 对象来源于不同的标准:随机分裂从数据集中随机选择对象;大众分裂从中选择最频繁的对象;逆变分裂从中识别出经常与地面真实对象并存但缺失的对象,使其最具挑战性. 在这项工作中,我们使用MS-COCO数据集(9 000个查询)作为代表性测试台,采用精确度和F1-分数作为评价指标,其表述如下: 精确度=T P + T N T P + F P + F N + T N ,\text{准确度=Frac{{ TP+TN}}{{ TP+FP+FN+TN}},(26) F1-分数=2×(精度×回忆) (精度+召回),\text{F1-分数}\2\times\frac}(\text{精度+时间→text{召回)\(\text{精度+text{召回)}\, (27)其中:召回=T P T P + F N,\text{召回=frac{{ TP+FN}},(28)精准=T P T P+F P.\text{精准=frac{{ TP+FP}}. blocks.en: MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) : MME is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the perceptual and cognitive faculties of LVLMs across 14 distinct subtasks. By employing a binary ”Yes/No” response framework, it effectively minimizes the interference of models’ linguistic inductive biases. While the perception track assesses fundamental attributes such as object existence, count, color, and position, the cognition track demands higher-level reasoning. In accordance with the protocol in ( Cho et al., 2025 ; Leng et al., 2023 ) , we evaluate different methods on four representative perception subtasks— Existence, Count, Position, and Color —and report the performance using the Score metrics ( Fu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: MME(Fu等人,2025年): MME是一个综合基准,旨在评价在14个不同子任务中LVLM的认知和认知能力。 通过使用二进制“是/否”反应框架,它有效地将模型语言诱导偏差的干扰降到最低。 虽然感知轨道评估物体存在,计数,颜色,位置等基本属性,但认知轨道要求更高层次的推理. 根据协议(Cho等人,2025年;Leng等人,2023年),我们评价四个代表性感知子任务——存在、伯爵、位置和肤色——的不同方法,并使用计分标准报告业绩(Fu等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: CHAIR ( Rohrbach et al., 2019 ) : The Caption Hallucination Assessment with Image Relevance (CHAIR) has been widely adopted to evaluate hallucinations in generative tasks. As a captioning-based benchmark, it prompts LVLMs to describe input images in detail and calculates the proportion of mentioned objects that do not exist in the ground-truth label pool. CHAIR provides two granularities: instance-level (CHAIR I {}_{\text{I}} ) and sentence-level (CHAIR S {}_{\text{S}} ), formulated as: CHAIR I = | { hallucinated objects } | all mentioned objects , \text{CHAIR}_{\text{I}}=\frac{{|\{{\text{hallucinated objects}}\}|}}{{{\text{all mentioned objects}}}}, (30) CHAIR S = | { caption with hallucinated objects } | all captions . \text{CHAIR}_{\text{S}}=\frac{{|\{{\text{caption with hallucinated objects}}\}|}}{{{\text{all captions}}}}. (31)

blocks.en: AMBER ( Wang et al., 2023 ) : AMBER is a recently developed multi-dimensional benchmark focused on hallucination evaluation in MLLMs. It offers fine-grained annotations and an automated, LLM-free evaluation pipeline, avoiding the high cost of GPT-4 APIs while ensuring efficiency and accuracy. Compared to CHAIR ( Rohrbach et al., 2019 ) , AMBER features a more extensive ground-truth label pool and covers existence, attributes, and relationships. We utilize the Generative task split (1,004 images, prompt: ” Describe this image. ”) and follow the standard metrics: Cover, Hal, and Cog ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . We randomly selected 200 images from the collection for testing.
blocks.zh: AMBER(王等人,2023年) : AMBER是最近开发的多维基准,侧重于MLLMs中的幻觉评价. 它提供精细的说明和一个自动化的无LLM评价管道,避免了GPT-4 API的高成本,同时确保效率和准确性. 相较于CHAIR(Rohrbach等人,2019年),AMBER具有更广阔的地面真实标签池,并覆盖存在,属性和关系. 我们使用基因任务拆分(1,004图像,即时:“描述这个图像。”)并遵循标准指标: Cover, Hal, and Cog (Wang等人,2023年). 我们随机选择了200张图片 从收集测试。

blocks.zh: A.8.2 基线

blocks.en: LLaVA-1.5 ( Liu et al., 2024a ) : As a prominent representative of end-to-end trained LVLMs, LLaVA-1.5 refines the original LLaVA framework by adopting a more powerful vision-language connector. It utilizes a CLIP-ViT-L/14 visual encoder and a Vicuna-v1.5 LLM, bridged by a two-layer MLP projection matrix. Despite its architectural simplicity, LLaVA-1.5 achieves SOTA performance on various academic benchmarks through the use of high-resolution image inputs and a diverse mix of instruction-tuning data. We select this model to validate FLASH’s effectiveness on the standard MLP-based vision-language paradigm. In this paper, we selected the 7B and 13B version of LLaVA-1.5.
blocks.zh: LLaVA-1.5(刘等人,2024a): 作为端到端训练LVLM的著名代表,LLaVA-1.5通过采用更强大的视觉语言连接器,完善了最初的LLaVA框架. 它使用一个CLIP-ViT-L/14视觉编码器和一个Vicuna-v1.5 LLM,由两个层的MLP投影矩阵连接. 尽管其建筑简洁,LLaVA-1.5通过使用高分辨率图像输入和多种组合的教学调制数据,实现了SOTA在各种学术基准上的性能. 我们选择这个模型是为了验证FLASH在基于MLP的标准视觉语言范式上的有效性. 在本文中,我们选择了LLaVA-1.5的7B和13B版本.

blocks.en: Shikra ( Chen et al., 2023a ) : Shikra is designed to excel in ”Referential Dialogue,” a task requiring the model to precisely ground objects mentioned in the conversation. Unlike models that rely on auxiliary detection heads or specialized pre-training, Shikra introduces a unified framework that handles spatial coordinates (bounding boxes) as natural language tokens. This design allows it to perform seamless spatial reasoning and object localization within a multi-turn dialogue. By including Shikra, we aim to demonstrate that FLASH can mitigate hallucinations even in models with strong inherent grounding capabilities. In this paper, we selected version 7B.
blocks.zh: Shikra (Chen等人, 2023a) : Shikra的设计是为了在“参考对话”中表现突出, 与依赖于辅助检测头或专业预训的模型不同,Shikra引入了处理空间坐标(边框)的统一框架作为自然语言符号. 这种设计允许它在多回合对话中进行无缝空间推理和对象本地化. 通过包括Shikra,我们的目标是表明FLASH即使在具有强大内在地基能力的模型中也能减轻幻觉. 在本文中,我们选择了7B版本.

blocks.zh: A.8.3 执行细节

blocks.en: For the compared method, we conducted testing using their official code. On the CHAIR dataset, we randomly sampled 500 images for inference using the query: “ Please help me describe this image in detail. ” For the AMBER dataset, we randomly sampled 200 images for inference testing, adhering to the official AMBER configuration ( Wang et al., 2023 ) with the query: “ Describe this image. ” For both generation tasks, we report the average results of tests conducted under two different random seed sets. Additionally, beyond the experimental details reported in Section 5.1 , we only modulate the first token for the discriminative task.
